creation(tag=meme_ST) ->In an age of chaos, a charter for exploration was signed to seek understanding among the stars.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_ST) ->Crews ventured outward, meeting the unknown with restraint and reason.
intro(tag=meme_ST) ->On the [place_summary] [place_name], a tradition formed at the briefing room where officers aligned purpose with principle.
conflict(tag=meme_ST) ->Ambition and fear tempted some to break the code, yet the chain of command held firm.
founderJoin(tag=meme_ST) ->Guided by a clear duty, the first captains pledged to protect life and uphold the Prime Directive.
victory(tag=meme_ST) ->By choosing restraint over conquest, they earned trust and forged lasting accords.
setup(tag=meme_ST) ->Discipline, science, and diplomacy became the tools of a new frontier.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_ST) ->Thus the doctrine spread: explore boldly, interfere lightly, act with honor.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_ST) ->First, we survived by force alone.
lesson(tag=meme_ST) ->Then we learned that understanding secures more than fear ever could.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_ST)->Hold to principle; let curiosity guide, not aggression.
archistBasis(tag=meme_ST) ->When minds touched distant knowledge, we saw that reason must govern power.
archistFact(tag=meme_ST) ->Technology without ethics invites catastrophe; thus doctrine restrains the hand.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_ST) ->In the end, those who balance security with compassion will endure.
animistFact(tag=meme_ST) ->Every world carries its own spirit; respect it and learn before you act.
